citeinfo.origin: National Operational Hydrologic Remote Sensing Center, 2004, doi:10.7265/N5TB14TC
citeinfo.title: SNODAS Snow Data Assimilation System Data Products (NSIDC G02158) (consolidated for NHF)

descript.abstract: NOAA NOHRSC SNODAS daily snow products distributed by NSIDC (collection G02158). Daily 1 km CONUS analysis combining satellite observations, ground stations, and an energy-balance snow model. Used as one source for the SWE calibration target. These data were consolidated to CF-1.6 NetCDF as part of the USGS National Hydrologic Model calibration-targets workflow.
descript.purpose: Document and distribute the consolidated form of the SNODAS Snow Data Assimilation System Data Products (NSIDC G02158) dataset as used in the USGS National Hydrologic Model workflow.
descript.supplinf: Source granules for SNODAS Snow Data Assimilation System Data Products (NSIDC G02158) were downloaded and consolidated to CF-1.6 NetCDF by the nhf-spatial-targets pipeline.
